target.title: fix(together): apply request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Together video generation provider's `buildTogetherVideoGenerationProvider()` was not forwarding user-configured provider request policies through `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest`. Other providers (openrouter #104835, xai #104836) already apply this policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The video generation provider now imports `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest` and passes the user-configured `request` parameter to `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig()`. All other provider logic, default request behavior, and non-HTTP transport paths are unchanged.

## User Impact

Users configuring custom request policies for Together video generation (e.g., extended timeouts for long video renders) now have those settings honored instead of silently ignored.

## Evidence

- **Regression**: `pnpm test:extension together` passed. Existing Together extension tests continue to pass with the added `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest` call.
- **Pattern consistency**: The `request:` parameter is passed identically to openrouter (#104835) and xai (#104836).
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/together/video-generation/video-generation-provider.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

AI-assisted: built with Codex

---

### Real behavior proof

Verified on PR head that `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest` is applied to `req.cfg?.models?.providers?.together?.request` in the video generation provider config. The import and call are identical in shape to the proven provider policy pattern (openrouter #104835, xai #104836). No behavioral change for users without a custom `request` config.
